name: Innkeeper Farley
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Innkeeper Farley welcomes travelers with food, beds, and hearthstones. Well-liked and observant, he keeps misplaced mail and hears the troubles of those on the road.

sections.title: A Goldshire Fixture
sections.body: Travelers bound for Stormwind, Westfall, and Duskwood find Innkeeper Farley behind the Lion's Pride Inn counter in Goldshire. He offers meals, ale, cheese, and a bed, and sets hearthstones for those who need one. With a welcoming hand and a sharp eye, Farley serves all who pass through this busy waystation and keeps order at the inn.

sections.title: The Courier's Abandoned Chest
sections.body: At the crossroads of Stormwind, Westfall, and Duskwood, Innkeeper Farley hears rumors and deals with strange travelers. Once, a courier fled into the night in terror, leaving his satchel behind. Farley safely stowed the leftover missives in an upstairs chest. Among them lies an undelivered letter addressed to former schoolmaster Stalvan Mistmantle, a clue for investigators tracing the fallen tutor's movements.

faq.answer: Innkeeper Farley serves travelers at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, offering rest and supplies to those traversing Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What does Farley know about Stalvan Mistmantle?
faq.answer: Farley recalls a terrified courier who fled the Lion's Pride Inn at night, leaving several deliveries behind. He safely stored the abandoned letters in an upstairs chest, including an undelivered letter addressed to Stalvan Mistmantle for investigators to retrieve.

faq.q: What services does Farley provide at the inn?
faq.answer: Farley sets hearthstones, rents rooms, and sells a wide variety of drinks, juices, and cheeses from across the Alliance. The cheeses include Alterac Swiss, Dalaran Sharp, and local Stormwind Brie.

angles.text: As a fresh recruit leaving Northshire Valley, you can bind your hearthstone and buy provisions at Farley's counter in the Lion's Pride Inn.
